outcome: physician preferences for level of care (comfort care vs intensive care)
lowest gestational age for interventions such as cesarean section
lowest gestational age for resuscitation interventions
cohort: 122 perinatal physicians (obstetricians and neonatologists) working in level III perinatal care centers in the Netherlands.
finding: There was wide variation in physician preferences for level of care at the limits of viability, especially for situations not specifically addressed in the 2010 Dutch guideline on perinatal practice in extreme prematurity.
